text: Plan amendment 2026-11-16 (branch claude/plan-measurement-contract-20261116 @eaea4c207): a row reached only through a broad reference, or only as one of several alternatives, is reported under its own coverage definition, not as recalled. The readout fixture adds broad-only and alternative-only cases, and the frozen protocol names the coverage definition the kappa uses. The source-indexed participant summary is one of the contract's three outputs (bd-01M7JCDMCX9H2BK6X17PRN3GHQ); DL4's readout should be that output, not a second export.
